summary: The firms openly proposed common hourly rates and commitments not to undercut them, then repeatedly made matching proposals and set matching rates. Their private notes also discuss preserving common rates and avoiding undercutting. The transcript contains a disclosure about a firm’s profit and allocated hours and references a statutory exemption for rate agreements; it shows no refusal or attempt to conceal coordination.
